2607.05479.title: Privilege and confidentiality in generative AI workflows
2607.05479.paper_summary: Generative AI (GenAI) systems store and process client data in three distinct ways: in the model's parameters through training and memorisation, in the context window during a live session, and in knowledge databases for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Each mode creates different and often counter-intuitive risks to confidentiality and legal professional privilege, and each calls for specific governance responses. Drawing on the first English and American decisions to address privilege and generative AI, UK and Munir v Secretary of State for the Home Department and United States v Heppner, on the orthodox privilege authorities against which those decisions must be read, and on recent computer science research, we explain the three modes of data storage and processing in terms accessible to practitioners and analyse the legal consequences of each. We then situate the analysis within the regulatory framework governing solicitors in England and Wales and within the ordinary principles of professional negligence, arguing that the standard of effective information governance (and with it the benchmark against which negligence and misconduct will be measured) is changing. Although we write primarily for SRA-regulated practitioners, our data-governance analysis is framed to extend to any jurisdiction in which the protection of privilege or professional secrecy depends on demonstrable confidentiality. The ultimate aim of this article is to help legal services professionals understand salient data leakage risks in GenAI systems and thereby facilitate a more responsible deployment of GenAI on client data and other sensitive material.
2607.05479.paper_summary_zh: 生成式人工智慧（GenAI）系統以三種不同的方式存儲和處理客戶數據：通過訓練和記憶在模型的參數中，在實時會話期間的上下文窗口中，以及在知識數據庫中以便檢索增強生成（RAG）。每種模式都會對保密性和法律專業特權產生不同且常常是反直覺的風險，並且每種模式都需要特定的治理回應。根據首批英美判決（UK和Munir v Secretary of State for the Home Department以及United States v Heppner）來處理特權和生成式人工智慧的情況，並參考那些判決必須解讀的正統特權權威以及近期的計算機科學研究，我們以實踐者易於理解的方式解釋數據存儲和處理的三種模式，並分析每種模式的法律後果。然後，我們將分析置於英格蘭和威爾士律師的監管框架內，以及專業過失的普通原則中，主張有效信息治理的標準（以及用以衡量過失和不當行為的基準）正在改變。雖然我們主要是為受SRA監管的實踐者撰寫，但我們的數據治理分析框架旨在擴展至任何依賴可證明的保密性來保護特權或專業秘密的管轄區。本文的最終目的是幫助法律服務專業人士理解生成式人工智慧系統中顯著的數據洩漏風險，從而促進對客戶數據和其他敏感材料的更負責任的生成式人工智慧部署。
